cards.ex: We should hit the road early to avoid traffic.
cards.exUz: Trafikdan qochish uchun erta yo'lga tushishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatga yoki safarga chiqishni boshlash, yo'lga tushish.

cards.ex: I prefer to travel off the beaten path and explore hidden gems.
cards.exUz: Men odamlardan uzoqda sayohat qilishni va yashirin marvaridlarni o'rganishni afzal ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur sayyohlik joylaridan uzoqda, odamlar kam boradigan joy.

cards.ex: I always try to travel light to avoid baggage fees.
cards.exUz: Men har doim yuk uchun to'lovlardan qochish uchun yengil sayohat qilishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Kam yuk bilan sayohat qilish, ortiqcha narsalarni olmaslik.

cards.ex: I needed a change of scenery, so I booked a trip to the mountains.
cards.exUz: Menga manzara o'zgarishi kerak edi, shuning uchun men tog'larga sayohatga buyurtma berdim.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik muhitdan farqli, yangi joyga borish.

cards.ex: Sometimes I just need to get away from it all and relax on a beach.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan shunchaki hamma narsadan uzoqlashib, plyajda dam olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik muammolardan va stressdan uzoqlashish, dam olish.

cards.ex: That restaurant is too touristy; let's find a local place.
cards.exUz: Bu restoran juda sayyohlik; mahalliy joy topaylik.
cards.uzDef: Sayyohlar ko'p bo'lgan, odatda qimmat va qiziqarsiz joy.

cards.ex: I'm going to soak up the sun on the beach all day.
cards.exUz: Men butun kunni plyajda quyoshda toblanaman.
cards.uzDef: Quyosh nuridan bahramand bo'lish, quyoshda dam olish.

cards.ex: The hotel room had a breathtaking view of the ocean.
cards.exUz: Mehmonxona xonasidan okeanning hayratlanarli manzarasi ochilib turardi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli va hayratlanarli manzara.

cards.ex: It's easy to get around the city by using public transportation.
cards.exUz: Shaharda jamoat transportidan foydalanib aylanib yurish oson.
cards.uzDef: Bir joydan boshqa joyga borish, sayohat qilish.

cards.ex: We're planning a trip for the long weekend in May.
cards.exUz: Biz may oyidagi uzoq dam olish kunlariga sayohat rejalashtiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan uzunroq dam olish kunlari (jumadan dushanbagacha).

cards.ex: I experienced culture shock when I first moved to Japan.
cards.exUz: Men birinchi marta Yaponiyaga ko'chib o'tganimda madaniy shokni boshdan kechirdim.
cards.uzDef: Yangi madaniyatga ko'nikishda his qilinadigan hayratlanish va qiyinchilik.

cards.ex: I always try to sample the local cuisine when I travel.
cards.exUz: Men sayohat qilganimda har doim mahalliy taomlardan tatib ko'rishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir hududga xos bo'lgan taomlar.

cards.ex: I can get by with my limited Spanish while traveling in Spain.
cards.exUz: Men Ispaniyada sayohat qilayotganda ispan tilim cheklangan bo'lsa ham, kun kechira olaman.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik bilan bo'lsada, zarur narsalar bilan ta'minlanish.

cards.ex: I need to pack a suitcase before my flight tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ertaga reysimdan oldin chamadon yig'ishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat uchun kiyim-kechak va boshqa narsalarni chamadonga joylash.

cards.ex: We need to check in at the hotel before going sightseeing.
cards.exUz: Biz sayohatga chiqishdan oldin mehmonxonada ro'yxatdan o'tishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Mehmonxona yoki aeroportda ro'yxatdan o'tish.

cards.ex: Drop by my hotel when you have time.
cards.exUz: Vaqtingiz bo'lganda mehmonxonamga kirib o'ting.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqtga biror joyga tashrif buyurish.

cards.ex: The tour guide was very knowledgeable about the city's history.
cards.exUz: Gid shahar tarixi haqida juda bilimli edi.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat paytida odamlarga joylar haqida ma'lumot beruvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: We traveled through Europe on a shoestring budget.
cards.exUz: Biz Yevropani juda kam pul bilan sayohat qildik.
cards.uzDef: Juda kam pul bilan, tejamkorlik bilan.

cards.ex: I finally got around to booking my vacation.
cards.exUz: Men nihoyat ta'tilimga buyurtma berishga vaqt topdim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilish uchun vaqt topish, amalga oshirish.

cards.ex: I'm really looking forward to my trip to Italy.
cards.exUz: Men Italiyaga sayohatimni juda kutmoqdaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir bo'lishini xursandchilik bilan kutish.

cards.ex: Traveling in the off season is cheaper and less crowded.
cards.exUz: Mavsumdan tashqari sayohat qilish arzonroq va odamlar kamroq bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Sayyohlar kam bo'ladigan vaqt, mavsum oxiri.

cards.ex: I have itchy feet and I'm ready for another adventure.
cards.exUz: Menda sayohatga chanqoqlik bor va men yana bir sarguzashtga tayyorman.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat qilish istagi juda kuchli bo'lish.

cards.ex: We spent the day going sightseeing in Paris.
cards.exUz: Biz kunni Parijda diqqatga sazovor joylarni tomosha qilish bilan o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatga sazovor joylarni tomosha qilish, ekskursiya qilish.

cards.ex: We spent the afternoon just taking in the sights of the city.
cards.exUz: Biz tushdan keyin shunchaki shahar manzaralaridan bahra oldik.
cards.uzDef: Joyning go'zalligini kuzatish va undan zavqlanish.

cards.ex: She's a seasoned traveler and knows all the best travel tips.
cards.exUz: U tajribali sayyoh va barcha eng yaxshi sayohat maslahatlarini biladi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p sayohat qilgan va tajribaga ega bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: We didn't have a detailed itinerary, we were just flying by the seat of our pants.
cards.exUz: Bizda batafsil reja yo'q edi, biz shunchaki vaziyatga qarab harakat qilayotgan edik.
cards.term: fly by the seat of pants
cards.uzDef: Rejasiz yoki tayyorgarliksiz, vaziyatga qarab harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I only had a week in Rome, but I got a taste of Italian culture.
cards.exUz: Menda Rimda faqat bir hafta bor edi, lekin men italyan madaniyatidan tatib ko'rdim.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt ichida biror narsadan tajriba orttirish.

cards.ex: Seeing the Northern Lights was a once in a lifetime experience.
cards.exUz: Shimoliy chiroqlarni ko'rish bir umrda bir marta bo'ladigan tajriba edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda noyob va unutilmas tajriba.

cards.ex: The band has been on the road for six months.
cards.exUz: Guruh olti oydan beri yo'lda.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatda, safarda bo'lish.

cards.ex: They decided to hitch a ride to the next town.
cards.exUz: Ular keyingi shaharga mashinada o'tishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Begona odamlardan tekin mashinada o'tishni so'rash.
